stories.headline: Google Cloud Pursues Financial Markets in FactSet Alliance
stories.body: Google Cloud and FactSet, a provider of data and artificial intelligence solutions to the financial markets, plan to jointly develop AI agents designed to assist with portfolio operations, deal advisory and corporate finance. stories.headline: Big payment firms, banks and fintechs add heft to Open USD stablecoin
stories.body: BNY, Huntington Bank, U.S. Bank, American Express, Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, and Coinbase are just a few of the companies that have signed on to use the dollar-backed stablecoin issued by technology firm Open Standard.
